description: React component for the Category view in a fashion e-commerce app, including product listing, filtering, sorting, and user authentication modal handling.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: React component class for displaying product categories with filtering, sorting, and user login modal.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes state and binds addToBag method.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches all products if not already loaded.

methods.name: addToBag
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart if user is authenticated; otherwise shows login modal.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the category page with product list, filters, sorting, pagination, and login/register modal.
